batches.prompt: A consistent set of 16 sci-fi defense WEAPONS. Strict TOP-DOWN bird eye view, barrel pointing toward BOTTOM of image, vertical symmetrical silhouette, exactly like the uploaded original weapon. Highly detailed hand-painted game inventory sprite: worn gunmetal, brushed steel, tiny brass bolts, strong sculpted shadows, small glowing accents. NOT flat vector, NOT side view, NOT an icon or silhouette. No pedestal, background, text, frame or hands. Real alpha transparency. Same camera, scale, lighting, realistic industrial art across all cells. Four columns are increasing equipment variants: utilitarian steel / tactical black and cyan / heavy brass / elite black and ivory. Each object occupies about 80 percent height and has a clearly recognizable distinct barrel and body. Row 1: four futuristic HANDGUN emplacements: service pistol, machine pistol, heavy .45, three-round pistol. Row 2: four ASSAULT RIFLE emplacements: carbine, burst rifle, marksman rifle, LMG. Row 3: four SUPPRESSION MACHINE PISTOLS: compact SMG, burst PDW, heavy slow-inducing PDW, rapid SMG. Row 4: four MAGNUM emplacements: revolver, fast revolver, giant .50 revolver, twin-round revolver. Maintain faithful detailed 3D-painted aesthetic of reference, with distinguishable silhouettes.

Sixteen futuristic defense weapon sprites in a strict 4 by 4 grid. Faithfully use the uploaded original weapon material and TOP DOWN orthographic camera. All muzzles point straight DOWN. Tall narrow silhouette, sculpted gunmetal, brushed steel, dark mechanical grooves, bolts, dramatic realistic painted metallic highlights. No vectors, side view, hands, pedestal, UI, letters or background. Real alpha transparency. Four variants left to right: standard utilitarian steel; tactical black/cyan; heavy brass/black; elite ivory/black. Row 1: four SHOTGUN emplacements, respectively pump action, automatic shotgun, twin barrel, drum magazine shotgun. Row 2: four SNIPER emplacements, respectively long bolt rifle, semi-auto precision rifle, huge anti-materiel sniper, twin burst sniper. Row 3: four ROCKET LAUNCHER emplacements, respectively RPG tube, guided missile launcher, rapid rocket launcher, double rocket tubes. Row 4: four CONTINUOUS LASER emplacements, respectively teal emitter with cooling fins, long thin prism beam lens, heavy ion cooling chamber, twin crystal laser array. Keep all 16 objects distinct but from the same polished hand-painted 3D industrial game art family, top light, no floor shadows. Match reference closely.

Sixteen game sprites, strict TOP DOWN bird-eye orthographic camera and 4x4 grid. Painterly realistic sculpted detail, strong highlights, dark outlines and rich materials, same premium sci-fi game art family as the reference. Genuine alpha transparent background, NO text, labels, floor, pedestal or frames. Row 1: four vertical FLAMETHROWER gun emplacements with barrel pointing DOWN: steel fuel jet, wide cyan nozzle sprayer, heavy brass inferno torch, elite ivory twin fuel rig. Distinct fuel tanks and pipes, small orange pilot flames. Row 2: four chunky map obstacles viewed from ABOVE: irregular jagged basalt BOULDER with pale cracks; translucent blue ICE crystal cluster; tangled alien green ORGANIC GROWTH with purple bulbs; reinforced amber industrial CARGO CRATE with steel straps. Row 3: a CLOSED futuristic gold/brass LOOT CHEST with cyan latch; same chest OPEN with glowing attachment parts inside; two steel hazardous waste BARRELS; a heavy mechanical circular turret BASE with subtle cyan indicator. Row 4: four very distinct top-down ALIEN creatures, legs/tendrils clearly visible: MENDER a luminous green insect medic with four leaf wings and healing bioluminescent sacs; JUGGERNAUT a broad armored cyan rhino beetle with thick stone-like plates; RAVAGER a fast orange-red scorpion with long claw legs; BROODMOTHER a huge purple spider with a swollen egg sac and eight legs. The aliens must be organic and unmistakable, each with a different silhouette. Center each sprite with enough transparent margin.

Seamless tileable top-down water texture for a premium sci-fi strategy game. Deep petrol teal water, subtle turquoise light on small flowing ripples, darker transparent-looking depths, organic smooth broad ripples and tiny highlights, realistic hand-painted game texture. Strict orthographic view directly from above. Completely fill the square edge to edge with WATER ONLY. No objects, coastline, rocks, land, borders, frame, transparency, perspective, text or grid. Opposite edges should match for seamless repetition. Restrained contrast and no bright white foam. Designed to tile across several adjacent map squares. Polished painterly material, not flat vector or noisy checkerboard pixels.
